examples.en: The hotel is near the station.

note.ru: Формы настоящего: I am, you/we/they are, he/she/it is

examples.en: I have a reservation for two nights.

examples.en: We have to deploy today.

examples.en: What do you do in the evenings?

I'm going to fix it tomorrow.
Do you know a good restaurant here?

Can I pay by card?
I can't log in.

note.ru: Модальный: без to и без -s; прошедшее — could; в других временах — be able to
